      "evidence": "c_transition now states that entering complete closes tools immediately, preserves the report, permits a final response, and dispatches no later calls. Both successful run transitions return f_report and explicitly tell the agent that tools are closed. Consequently, post-success calls cannot reach the pending-run default under the specified contract. This is a design-level repair, not verified implementation behavior."
